name: Chichi's Typing Battle
summary:
Race Chichi the cat in a typing duel. You both type the same Korean tongue twister at the same time, and whoever finishes first wins the round. Lose once and the run is over.

The words start easy and get nasty: doubled consonants and glued vowels first, then words with stacked final consonants, then short tongue twisters, then full-line twisters. Chichi starts at 180 keystrokes per minute, gains 25 every round and tops out at 700.
